pages.title: Solar Panels in California (2026): Cost, Rules, Worth It
pages.note: Statewide residential solar guide and cost_value hub. Retitled: the old title's '$3.30/W median' is not in LBNL's text (re-checked 2026-09-23), so the page now uses LBNL Tracking the Sun 2024's stated $3.20-$5.50/W band (same benchmark as src/data/solar-cost-benchmark.ts) plus the 2026 update's -$0.50/W change. Links cost, financing, incentives, NEM and battery hubs. topic-hubs.ts hubPageLabel for cost_value still says '$3.30/W Median Cost and Sizing' and should be updated at integration.

pages.title: Baker Electric San Diego vs Baker Home Energy: Solar Review
pages.note: Both Baker sites re-read 2026-09-23 and attributed as the companies' own statements. Added FAQPage schema, 'baker solar' / 'baker electric california' answers, section breadcrumb (/solar-installers) and HubSpokeLinks. pages.title: California Solar Resources: Official Tools and Data (2026)
pages.note: Sourced directory of official tools, covering both senses of 'solar resource' (NREL sunlight data) and the agencies behind a solar decision. Holder /solar-cost/san-diego (cities agent): link request in link_requests; the page links /solar-cost/san-diego.

pages.title: Worst Solar Companies in California: How to Check a Record
pages.note: No ranking. Stated method on the page: a company appears only for an event on a public court or state record, linked to the record. Lists three residential solar bankruptcies read on CourtListener 2026-09-23 (SunPower 24-11649 D. Del.; Sunnova 25-90160 S.D. Tex.; Freedom Forever 26-10522 D. Del., now listed Ch. 7). Block 5 hub_page_map had this cluster as 'attach' to the hub; built as the CSV's CREATE and linked from the hub.

pages.title: (section) How solar production changes month by month
pages.note: Built as a section, /solar-panels-california#production-by-month, not a standalone page: 20/mo and 0 GSC impressions is under the SEO/24 §5.10 standalone threshold (Block 5 maps cluster 536 to a section). A month-by-month kWh table needs NREL PVWatts output, and the PVWatts API (developer.nrel.gov) is blocked from this environment (proxy CONNECT 502), so no monthly figures are stated. No URL created; nothing to add to the sitemap.
